name: aim-gap-assist
description: ANSWER B to the aim gap (?aim=assist): byte-identical inputs to aim-gap-8way.json — the player still fires level from a standing muzzle and never touches DOWN — but each shot leaves along a heading corrected by at most 8 degrees toward a hostile already inside a 16-degree cone. Expected: the same ~20 shots now kill the houndframe. The cap is what keeps this generosity: at the assist's maximum range the correction cannot reach a neighbouring lane (asserted in pathcheck), so it can never pick a target the player was not pointing at.
